description: Per transaction and trader type, count the behaviour-analysis records.

c.request: Take transactions that have advanced behaviour analysis (`advancedbehavior.translink` = `transactionrecord.transreg`) and link them to their trader (`trdref` = `tradereg`), dropping anything unmatched. For each transaction and trader type, find how many there are and what share of the overall total that is. Then, for each trader type, give the average count and the average share, unrounded. Per transaction and trader type, count the behaviour-analysis records.
c.sql: WITH transaction_counts AS (SELECT tr.transreg, t.tradekind, COUNT(ab.abhvreg) AS behavior_count FROM transactionrecord AS tr JOIN advancedbehavior AS ab ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY tr.transreg, t.tradekind), transaction_shares AS (SELECT tradekind, behavior_count, behavior_count::numeric / SUM(behavior_count) OVER () AS behavior_share FROM transaction_counts) SELECT tradekind, AVG(behavior_count::numeric) AS average_count, AVG(behavior_share) AS average_share FROM transaction_shares GROUP BY tradekind ORDER BY tradekind;

b.request: For each transaction with advanced behaviour analysis and a matching trader, count its behaviour-analysis records by trader type and calculate its share of all matched behaviour-analysis records; then, for each trader type, report the unrounded average count and average share across transactions
b.sql: WITH transaction_counts AS (SELECT tr.transreg, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS behavior_count FROM transactionrecord AS tr JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref JOIN advancedbehavior AS ab ON ab.translink = tr.transreg GROUP BY tr.transreg, t.tradekind), transaction_shares AS (SELECT tradekind, behavior_count, behavior_count::numeric / SUM(behavior_count) OVER () AS behavior_share FROM transaction_counts) SELECT tradekind, AVG(behavior_count::numeric) AS avg_behavior_count, AVG(behavior_share) AS avg_behavior_share FROM transaction_shares GROUP BY tradekind ORDER BY tradekind;

a.request: Link each advanced behaviour record (`advancedbehavior`) to its transaction (`translink` = `transactionrecord.transreg`) and then to that transaction's trader (`trdref` = `trader.tradereg`), dropping anything without a match. For each pair of transaction and trader type (`tradekind`), count the behaviour records and work out that count's share of the total count across all pairs. Then, for each trader type, give the trader type, the average count per pair and the average share per pair, unrounded.
a.sql: WITH pair_counts AS (SELECT tr.transreg, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS behaviour_count FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY tr.transreg, t.tradekind), pair_shares AS (SELECT tradekind, behaviour_count, behaviour_count::numeric / SUM(behaviour_count) OVER () AS share FROM pair_counts) SELECT tradekind, AVG(behaviour_count::numeric) AS average_count_per_pair, AVG(share) AS average_share_per_pair FROM pair_shares GROUP BY tradekind;

d.request: Join `advancedbehavior` to `transactionrecord` on `advancedbehavior.translink = transactionrecord.transreg`, then link each transaction to its trader on `trdref = tradereg`, excluding unmatched rows. For each transaction and trader type, count the behaviour-analysis records and calculate their share of the overall record count. Then, for each trader type, return the unrounded average count and average share.
d.sql: WITH transaction_counts AS (SELECT tr.transreg, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS behavior_count FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY tr.transreg, t.tradekind), transaction_shares AS (SELECT tradekind, behavior_count, behavior_count::numeric / SUM(behavior_count) OVER () AS record_share FROM transaction_counts) SELECT tradekind, AVG(behavior_count) AS average_count, AVG(record_share) AS average_share FROM transaction_shares GROUP BY tradekind ORDER BY tradekind;
